evidence: Labeled Wallet and directly affects the in-memory hygiene of wallet cryptographic material, including passphrase key derivation and BIP32 seed derivation.
rationale: Cleanses CSHA512 state on destruction to prevent wallet passphrase and BIP32 seed material from lingering in process memory. The PR description notes that 'in CCrypter::BytesToKeySHA512AES the final state holds the key and IV derived from the passphrase, [and] the two hashers in CHMAC_SHA512 hold BIP32 seed and key material'. This is a solid defense-in-depth security hygiene improvement, though reasonably deferrable.
